systems.tiers: national, fed by the sector ministries and the national, regional, sectoral and section land commissions

note: The general regulation of the land law: land concessions, cadastre and land commissions only. It names the Direção-Geral da Identificação Civil, dos Registos e do Notariado as a land institution and says nothing of civil registration. The capture is truncated at art. 22 and partly garbled.
